_comment: Minimal MCP surface for the Mode A worker dispatch. Loaded via --mcp-config --strict-mcp-config in triage.sh. The worker also has WebFetch/WebSearch built-in tools for public URLs (Google Doc public-share links, web pages). For authenticated Google Workspace reads (private Docs, Drive), the worker shells out to the `gws` CLI via Bash — no GWS MCP needed. Coda and Atlassian are MCP because they need authenticated API access and there's no equivalent CLI.
